description: Applause and cheering of a crowd during a curtain call. The cheering and clapping varies in intensity as different actors come out to take their bows. Some spontaneous cheering at the end, too- the lights went out but the crowd could still see the drummer's glow-in-the-dark "Green Lantern" shirt. Recorded with a Canon GL-2 internal microphone.
name: curtain_call-16.flac
